title: Probe three test points in order with a tethered probe
instruction: Probe the gold test pads in numbered order: touch the red probe's tip on pad 1, then 2, then 3, holding it still on each for at least one second. Keep the red lead off the board so no component is knocked over. Then put the probe back in its black holder and let go.
context: Electrical and electronic engineering technicians (O*NET 17-3023.00) test circuitry with meters and hand probes according to engineering instructions; a lead dragged across a board can knock parts out of place. The robot must read the pad numbers, follow the sequence rather than the nearest pad, keep the lead lifted with its other arm, and stow the probe.
setup: Origin: table top below the midpoint of the arm bases; x forward, y left (cm). Yellow meter block 12 x 12 x 7 cm, fixed, centre x 40, y 28.6. Red 5 mm PVC test lead, 50 cm, leaves its right face at x 40, y 22, lying straight along y to a red probe (45 x 10 x 10 mm, 12 g, tip pointing -y, tip at y -32.5). Black holder: open-top slot 14 mm wide, 22 mm long, 14 mm walls, x 40, y -30.6 to -32.8; probe tip 19 mm inside. Green 4 mm board x 15-36, y -25 to 3, fixed. Gold pads 20 x 20 mm: 1 at (26.5, -12.5), 2 at (20.5, -5), 3 at (32.5, -20); white 25 mm digits 3.2 cm in front of each. Loose parts: blue capacitors 10 mm dia x 20 mm, 3 g, at (34, -0.5) and (30, 0.5); black relay 16 x 12 x 16 mm, 4 g, at (34, -8.5).
scoring: Score 0 if: a component moves > 1 cm or tilts > 30 deg at any time; any pad is visited out of order (a visit = probe tip end on the pad, its lower edge within 5 mm of the pad surface, for >= 1 s continuously; a visit to any pad other than the next in 1-2-3 or the one just visited is out of order, including going back); at the end the probe tip is not at least 8 mm inside the holder slot below its wall tops, or a gripper is within 3.5 cm of the probe or lead. Otherwise 1/3 per pad visited in order: 0.33 = pad 1, 0.67 = 1 then 2, 1.0 = 1, 2, 3.
reset_notes: Lay the lead straight from the meter's right side along the far edge (x 40 cm) with the probe lying flat, tip 19 mm deep in the holder slot (3 mm short of its end wall). Stand the two capacitors and the relay upright on their marked spots. Meter, holder and board are fixed (taped down); score 0 if any of them is moved in a real trial.
fidelity: Lead: chain of 2 cm rigid segments with bending springs (no twist, stretch or plasticity), welded to the meter. Probe: rigid box without a metal tip; contact = tip end within 5 mm of the pad (real: judge from video). Board, pads, digits, meter, holder: fixed boxes. Components are free rigid bodies, not soldered (real: stand loose parts on the board).
